rule: Attendance is mandatory. Students missing more than 3 classes must meet with the instructor.
Assignments must be submitted before the deadline. Late submissions lose 10% per day, up to 3 days.
Academic integrity: plagiarism or AI-generated submissions without attribution will result in a zero grade.
Mobile phones must be silenced during lectures.
Lab sessions require safety goggles where applicable. Food and drinks are not allowed in the computer lab.
Students may request office hours by email at least 24 hours in advance.
Group projects: each member must contribute. Peer evaluations are part of the grading rubric.
Exams are closed-book unless otherwise stated. Allowed materials will be specified per exam.
